name: Rabbi L. Astaroth
source:
A Royale participant who claims to have known Lucy when she was alive but couldn't even remember her name.

She has murderous intent for people who stand in her way. It's easy to read her emotions and she often stutters.

However, contrary to her personality, she is highly skilled in combat and can wield knives.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
